column1: # The `just test-wayland-x86` scenario: the Wayland Phase 1a handshake, driven by
# One step per line, as `tools/smoke/scenario.tsv` documents: the command, a tab, and the
# whole line its output must produce.
# `waylandtest` forks: the child serves one Wayland client over `/run/wayland-test` on
# `/dev/uds` (its own path, so it does not collide with `/sbin/wlserver` on
# `/run/wayland-0`), and the parent connects, enumerates the registry (`wl_compositor`,
# `wl_shm`, `wl_output`, `wl_seat`) and completes a `wl_display.sync`. It prints the
# line below only if every global arrived and the callback fired; a missing reply
# hangs the read loop, which the gate reports as a stopped scenario.
